dim1_row: Environmental richness — More scatter variety (chunks, dead leaves); cluster scatter near trees/rock

outputs.description: Produces 3 new low-saturation decal PNGs. Imports palette.py READ-ONLY. Does NOT edit _gen_fix_audit.py, _gen_sprites.py, or palette.py.

outputs.saturation: ROCK_MD sat ~0.084 — well below all pawn cloth

outputs.description: Self-attaches via [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)]. Hidden DontDestroyOnLoad GO. FindFirstObjectByType idempotency guard. Deterministic seed 98765. Places stone_chunk_small + dead_leaves + pebble_scatter sparsely on terrain AND clusters stone_chunk_small near TreeEntity positions (1.5wu radius, 2 per tree) and pebble_scatter near StoneVeinEntity positions (1.8wu radius, 3 per vein). All reads of TreeEntity/StoneVeinEntity are READ-ONLY (transform.position only). sortingOrder=1 — same as existing V2 scatter, below pawns (9+), structures (10+), above terrain (0).

qa_flags: QA FLAG: Confirm stone_chunk_small.png / dead_leaves.png / pebble_scatter.png are present in Assets/Sprites/ and load without 'sprite null' console warnings. If any decal appears as a magenta dot, the PNG is not bundled — ensure Assets/Sprites/*.png are included in the build (Resources/ folder or SpriteAtlas).
QA FLAG: Verify sortingOrder=1 renders NEW decals BELOW pawns (9+) and structures (10+), and ABOVE terrain tiles (0). Eye should land on pawns first.

QA FLAG: Clustering — confirm some stone_chunk_small decals appear near tree trunks (within ~1.5 world units) and some pebble_scatter decals near StoneVeins (within ~1.8 world units). Placement is deterministic (seed 98765) — same layout every run.
QA FLAG: scene-wiring is ZERO. Self-attaches via RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod. Confirm no double-attach on scene reload (idempotency guard).

QA FLAG: Sprite import settings — PPU=16 (stone_chunk_small and dead_leaves are 8-10px sprites at PPU16 = 0.5-0.625 world units). pebble_scatter 10x6 at PPU16 = 0.625x0.375 world units. All point filter. Confirm TextureImporter settings are applied.
acceptance_binary: A wide screenshot shows MORE incidental variety than before (new chunk/leaf/pebble decals visibly scattered, some clustered near trees/rock). They recede (eye lands on pawns first). Nothing brighter than a pawn. No tile-seam grid pattern. No clutter.
note: Unity not run per lane contract. QA verifies after merge.
